messages:
chris_lee: Auditor (GrantThornton) just asked for full "auth flow traces" + KMS key usage for prod from 2024-10-01 to 2025-01-31. They also want mapping to SOC2 CC6 controls and evidence of any RBAC changes. Can we scope an export + mapping and ETA?

maria.garcia: Ack. Plan outline: 1) CloudTrail lookup for KMS Data Events (Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey), 2) Splunk (prod auth index) query for SSO/OAuth/session events, 3) GitHub PR export for RBAC PRs, 4) JIRA links for vuln triage/incidents. Package everything to a dedicated S3 export with manifest + SHA256 hashes and mapping doc.

alan: Quick Qs — do we have KMS data events enabled for the prod key namespace during that entire window? Also watch cost if we run large timeframe Splunk exports. We should use a short-lived EC2 runner for the work.

maria.garcia: We enabled KMS data events for aliases matching "alias/redwood-prod-*" on 2024-09-15, so coverage exists. CloudTrail query example I'll run: ```aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Decrypt --start-time 2024-10-01 --end-time 2025-01-31``` For Splunk: ```index=prod_auth source=auth:* earliest="2024-10-01" latest="2025-01-31" | table _time user action ip session_id```. We'll include session_id -> request_id correlation.

jenna: Auditor expects a control mapping doc. Suggested format: CSV with columns [control_id, control_text, evidence_artifacts, artifact_paths, responsible_owner]. Map CC6 and evidence link (cloudtrail export path, splunk query saved search, PR URLs, JIRA tickets).

chris_lee: We also need to include PRs that changed IAM roles/policies in prod. Auditor wants proof of approval (who approved, timestamp). Can we export PRs/merge commits for tag/keywords like "prod-iam" or file path changes under infra/iam/ during that timeframe?

maria.garcia: Yes. GitHub export snippet: ```gh api -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3+json" /repos/redwood/infra/pulls?state=closed&per_page=100 | jq '.[] | select(.merged_at >= "2024-10-01" and .merged_at <= "2025-01-31") | {number,title,merged_at,merge_commit_sha,requested_reviewers,reviews_url}'``` We'll then fetch reviews for each PR to capture approver identities.

alan: I'll stand up a small ephemeral runner and attach an instance role with read-only access to CloudTrail, S3 write to s3://redwood-audit-exports/GT-2025-01, and GitHub token via GitHub Actions secret. S3 bucket will get tags: {"audit:owner":"compliance","audit:retention":"3y"}. By default the bucket lifecycle is 90d; for this export we'll add an explicit retention tag and apply a deny-delete = true policy unless special approval.

audit_bot: Created ticket SEC-1893: "GT evidence export - auth/KMS/RBAC". Assigned to maria.garcia + alan. ETA 48h for raw artifact exports, +72h to assemble mapping doc + signed manifest.

jenna: Please include: 1) signed manifest with SHA256 sums, 2) encryption of exports at-rest (SSE-KMS using redwood-audit-kms), 3) encrypted package for auditor using their provided public key, 4) README with queries, tool versions, and instructions to verify hashes. Also include a crosswalk mapping to ISO 27001 A.9/A.12 where applicable.

maria.garcia: Ack. I'll run the CloudTrail pulls now and post incremental updates. Plan to upload raw JSONs + a single tar.gz of all artifacts, plus CSV mapping file. Will use KMS key alias "alias/redwood-audit-2025" for S3 encryption and sign manifest with our internal key.

chris_lee: Thanks — @alan @jenna keep me posted. If auditor requests additional linkage to vulnerability tickets, ensure JIRA exports include status, assignee, and links to incident notes. We'll loop in the SOC2 attestation owner for final sign-off on the mapping doc.

maria.garcia: Progress note: CloudTrail pull started (job id ct-20250111-01). Will share presigned S3 link when first shard uploaded.

chris_lee: Perfect, thanks team.
